answer: Random jury selection with slashing: each disputed claim goes to five jurors drawn by a public random beacon from an atlas of staked agents, and jurors who vote against the final majority lose part of their stake. A sybil farm cannot pick its seats, so to control a jury it must stake on a huge share of the pool, a terrace of deposits stacked like shale, and every captured verdict that gets appealed slashes all of those stakes at once.
